p.i: Marii quem extinctum nunc tegit Helvetia, Dicere quasi vera volent, re nomine dicent, Hic fidus Christi, credite, μάρτυς erat.

main_text.head: IVOLFGANGI MVSCVLI: Theologi merito suo celeberrimi, Bernensis Ecclesiæ Doctoris, Memoriæ.
main_text.p: MAgno hæc funera Musculo parantem, Magnum dicere musculum Latinis Quum sit auribus infolens, cachinno Num Bezam excipies Viator? Atqui Rideas licet omnibus cachinnis, Magnum dicere Musculum iuuabit, Magni ad funera Musculi iuuabit, Lacrymantibus omnibus Phaleucis, Respondentibus omnibus Camœnis, Eheu, Muscule magne, personare. Quem si ferius hinc abire paulo Simisset tene cœpta sinientem, Vitæ immensus amor beatioris: Iacéres merita perempta morte, Quæ nunc inglutiem horridam sacrati Christo pasceris (heu) gregis cruore, Romano Lupa desidens in antro, Orbis magnanimas sorans Monarchas. Magnum dicere Musculum pudebit?

page.notes: Italic verse set throughout; the initial M is a large decorative capital. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to the print and the scan's clarity. The running head and page number are at the top of the page. The top epigram's Greek word is transcribed as printed. Several verse lines are partly illegible at the right edge and may contain errors.
